# Themba Mndebele — Portfolio & Technical Profile

> Frontend Developer specialising in React, TypeScript, Next.js, and modern UI/UX engineering.

## Summary
Themba Mndebele is a South Africa-based Frontend Developer with approximately 4 years of professional experience building high-performance, accessible, and resilient web applications.

## Technical Skills & Expertise
- Languages & Core: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3/PostCSS
- Frameworks & UI: React 19, Next.js 16 (App Router), Tailwind CSS
- State Management & Async Data: Zustand, React Query (TanStack), Context API
- Testing & QA: Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, JSDOM
- Backend & Databases (Integration): Appwrite, Dexie.js (IndexedDB), REST APIs, KaTeX
- AI Tooling & Workflows: Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, OpenCode, Cline, CodeRabbit

## Featured Projects

### 1. Lumnie — Interactive STEM learning for South African learners
- Description: A STEM playground for Grade 10–12 learners, bringing mathematics, science and technology to life through mini-lessons, interactive 3D models, quizzes and hands-on puzzles.
- Live Demo: https://lumnie.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/thembaxx/lumnie
- Case Study: https://themba.dev/projects/lumnie
- Key Tech: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Three.js, PixiJS, KaTeX

### 2. CityLit — A playful guide to South African cities
- Description: A mobile-first discovery experience across South Africa. Explore an interactive province map, rotate illustrated landmarks, search sourced places and save somewhere worth visiting.
- Live Demo: https://citylit.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/thembaxx/citylit
- Case Study: https://themba.dev/projects/citylit
- Key Tech: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, MapLibre

### 3. Hydromental — Elementals · an interactive chemistry playground
- Description: Explore all 118 chemical elements through interactive atoms, plain-language stories and everyday connections. A playful chemistry experience with sourced properties, games and a personal discovery journal.
- Live Demo: https://hydromental.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/thembaxx/hydromental
- Case Study: https://themba.dev/projects/hydromental
- Key Tech: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Three.js, Motion, Radix UI

### 4. ProcodiApp — Little Less · South African grocery promotions
- Description: A grocery promotion finder that puts South African stores, source-backed offers and qualifying terms in one place. Search, filter and save offers, with freshness and expiry checks that hide outdated listings.
- Live Demo: https://procodiapp.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/thembaxx/procodiapp
- Case Study: https://themba.dev/projects/procodiapp
- Key Tech: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, Motion

### 5. mypets — Nuzzle · an everyday pet care companion
- Description: A companion for everyday pet care, with personal pet profiles, care schedules and species-specific learning. Routines, observations and progress stay on the device, with offline support and optional calendar export.
- Live Demo: https://mypets-pi.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/thembaxx/mypets
- Case Study: https://themba.dev/projects/mypets
- Key Tech: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Three.js, Motion, Transformers.js

### 6. leesmaat — English and Afrikaans literacy, five minutes at a time
- Description: A bilingual reading companion with separate placement levels for English and Afrikaans. Read, practise comprehension, save vocabulary and annotate passages, with an offline archive for learning without a connection.
- Live Demo: https://leesmaat.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/thembaxx/leesmaat
- Case Study: https://themba.dev/projects/leesmaat
- Key Tech: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, Firebase
